theses.thesis: The AI Compute theme is the detector's headline and eligible under the trend gate, indicating a persistent uptrend without crowding. Despite narrow breadth (0.059), the theme benefits from sustained macro narrative attention (AI/tech headlines dominate). With no overcrowding and the absolute trend gate passing, a conditional overweight lean is taken, expecting outperformance relative to the CSI 300 over the next month, contingent on momentum not reversing sharply.
